title: 第22章流放之地第23章 千奴朝拜
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
鲁大师站在山门碎光里，六根手指的左手垂在身侧，破烂的矿奴服被冲击波吹得猎猎作响。
灵石灯盏全碎了，但他的身体自己在发光——不是灵力，是残魂燃烧时那种将灭未灭的微光。
“师父！”苏意冲过去。
鲁大山抬手制止了他。
“别碰。
老夫不是活人——是残魂附在鲁某生前炼的最后一件灵兵上，强行凝形。”
他摊开左手，掌心有一块碎成两半的玉佩。
那是他死前用自己的命元炼成的替死玉符，能存一缕残魂十二个时辰，时辰一到魂飞魄散。
“老夫在旧矿道里感应到你——你不但活着走出了废矿坑，还杀了牛皋、破了擂台赛、拔了炼魂钉。
老夫没白认你这个徒弟。”
他扫了一眼赵铁骨血肉模糊的后背，又看了一眼擂台上正在调息的白骨长棍，“连铁骨门的老骨头都让你给拔出来了。”
然后他看见了擂台边缘那群瑟瑟发抖的青云宗弟子。
他的目光定在一个年轻弟子脸上。
那人缩在人群最里面，脸埋进膝盖，只露出半个后脑勺。
鲁大师走过去。
六根手指的左手揪着那人的后领把他提起来，月光照在那张年轻的脸上——十七八岁，眉眼俊秀，下巴有一颗红痣。
“赵平。”鲁大山的声音很轻，“老夫在青云宗收的第一个弟子。
所有内门外门弟子里最疼的就是你。
老夫把六合门不传之秘‘照心镜’传了你一个人。”
赵平的脸白得像纸，嘴唇发抖。

“你出卖老夫的时候，跟吴长老说的原话是‘鲁大山私藏六合门秘典，意图叛宗’。
老夫被贬矿奴那天，你来送行没有？
没有。
老夫在废矿坑里等了三个月，等来了苏意。”
赵平张了张嘴，想说什么——想求饶，想解释。
但鲁大山没有给他机会。
六根手指按在他天灵盖上，没发力，只是按着，像抚摸。
手指抖了一下。
然后收回来。
“你是老夫教出来的。
你的命是老夫给的。
现在老夫不杀你——你回青云宗，告诉所有人，鲁大山死了，死在废矿坑里，矿奴服没换，骨头灰撒在石壁上。”
他松开手。
赵平踉跄退了两步，难以置信地看着自己的师父，然后转身跌跌撞撞跑向山门。
跑到一半，鲁大山的声音从背后追上去——“照心镜你还练不会，你心不正。”
赵平没回头。
脚步声在山门外的碎石路上越来越远，最后被风吹散了。
鲁大山转过身看着苏意。
残魂越来越淡，脚底的微光开始往上蔓延，小腿已经在缓慢气化。
“老夫收回刚才那句话——不是没白认你这个徒弟，是这辈子最值的事。
content_en:
Master Lu stood in the broken light of the mountain gate, his six-fingered left hand hanging by his side, and his tattered mining slave uniform made a rustling sound from the shock wave.
The spiritual stone lamps were all broken, but his body was glowing on its own—not spiritual power, but the kind of glimmer that was dying but not extinguished when the remaining soul was burning.
"Master!" Su Yi rushed over.
Lu Dashan raised his hand to stop him.
"Don't touch.
I'm not a living person - it's the remnant soul attached to the last spiritual weapon that Lu made before his death, and it was forcibly condensed. "
He spread his left hand, and in the palm of his hand was a jade pendant broken into two halves.
It was a jade talisman that he made with his own life force before his death. It could preserve a ray of his soul for twelve hours, and when the time was up, his soul would fly away.
"I sensed you in the old mine tunnel - you not only walked out of the abandoned mine alive, but you also killed Niu Gao, defeated the group competition, and pulled out the soul-refining nail.
I didn’t recognize you as my disciple in vain. "
He glanced at Zhao Tiegu's bloody back, and then at the long bone stick on the ring where he was adjusting his breath, "You even pulled out the old bones of the Tiegu Sect."
Then he saw the group of trembling Qingyun Sect disciples at the edge of the ring.
His eyes were fixed on the face of a young disciple.
The man huddled in the innermost part of the crowd, his face buried in his knees, with only half of the back of his head exposed.
Master Lu walked over.
The six-fingered left hand grasped the man's back collar and lifted him up. The moonlight shone on that young face - seventeen or eighteen years old, with handsome features and a red mole on his chin.
"Zhao Ping." Lu Dashan's voice was very soft, "The first disciple I accepted in the Qingyun Sect.
Of all the inner and outer disciples, you are the one who feels the most pain.
I have passed on the secret of the Liuhe Sect, the ‘Heart Mirror’, to you alone. "
Zhao Ping's face was as white as paper and his lips were trembling.
"When you betrayed me, the original words you told Elder Wu were, 'Lu Dashan secretly hid the Liuhe Sect's secret code with the intention of betraying the clan.'
On the day when I was demoted to a mining slave, did you come to see me off?
No.
I waited in the abandoned mine for three months until Su Yi came. "
Zhao Ping opened his mouth, wanting to say something - wanting to beg for mercy, wanting to explain.
But Lu Dashan didn't give him a chance.
Six fingers pressed on his Tianling Cap, exerting no force, just pressing, like stroking.
His fingers trembled.
Then take it back.
"You were taught by me.
Your life was given by me.
I won't kill you now - you go back to Qingyun Sect and tell everyone that Lu Dashan is dead. He died in the abandoned mine. The mine slave clothes were not changed, and the ashes of his bones were scattered on the stone wall. "
He let go.
Zhao Ping staggered back two steps, looked at his master in disbelief, then turned around and stumbled towards the mountain gate.
Halfway through the run, Lu Dashan's voice caught up with him from behind - "You still can't practice looking in the mirror, your heart is not right."
Zhao Ping did not look back.
The footsteps got farther and farther on the gravel road outside the mountain gate, and were finally blown away by the wind.
Lu Dashan turned around and looked at Su Yi.
The remnant soul became fainter and fainter, the shimmer on the soles of the feet began to spread upwards, and the calves were slowly vaporizing.
"I take back what I just said - it's not in vain that I recognized you as my disciple, it is the most valuable thing in my life.
